name: Ambulance & fire equipment
source: Identifiers checked 2026-10-31 against the bundled IEEE OUI registry and Bluetooth SIG assigned numbers (company IDs, member UUIDs); names are vendor/model strings. The same equipment is used in hospitals, clinics, industry and training — a hit means 'possible ambulance / fire crew', not proof.

rules.label: Ambulance defibrillator / patient monitor
rules.note: ZOLL Medical member UUIDs 0xFE22 / 0xFE23 (X Series monitors, AEDs), Physio-Control OUI 40:BD:9E (LIFEPAK), Philips Medical Systems Cardiac & Monitoring 00:09:5C (HeartStart / MRx), Schiller 00:0D:B8. ZOLL LifeVest (patient-worn, 00:22:52) deliberately excluded.

rules.label: Stryker ambulance equipment (stretcher / LUCAS / LIFEPAK)
rules.note: Stryker SIG company 0x0A5F, member UUID 0xFC6E and OUI 00:0D:D1 — powered ambulance stretchers/loaders, LUCAS chest-compression devices and LIFEPAK. Also hospital beds and equipment.

rules.label: Transport ventilator
rules.note: Weinmann (MEDUMAT) OUI 48:91:53; Hamilton T1 and Dräger Oxylog by name. Common in ambulances and retrieval aircraft.

rules.label: Firefighter breathing apparatus / gas detector
rules.note: MSA (SIG company 0x01A4 MSA Innovation; OUIs 00:21:2B MSA Auer, CC:41:8E) — G1 SCBA, LUNAR, ALTAIR gas detectors; Dräger (company 0x04BC, member UUID 0xFCDA, OUIs 00:10:5D, 00:30:E6, F0:E5:C3) — PSS SCBA, X-am gas detectors (Dräger also makes hospital equipment); 3M Scott by name. 'MSA Group' optical-transceiver OUIs are a different organisation and excluded.

rules.label: Fire apparatus / specialty emergency vehicle
rules.note: Oshkosh Corporation OUI 80:84:A9 (owner of Pierce fire apparatus; also JLG and defence vehicles); Rosenbauer, E-ONE, Spartan, Magirus, Varley (AU) and Mills-Tui (AU) by name.

rules.label: Thermal imaging camera
rules.note: FLIR Systems (SIG company 0x0AE9; OUIs 00:1B:D8, 00:40:7F) — K-series firefighting thermal cameras; also used by trades and hunters.
